payload.title: [Fig. 1] Motivation for the study
payload.description: This workflow reproduces Figure 1 from a scientific paper, focusing on climate reconstructions and simulations. It processes and visualizes data using various Python libraries, comparing ensemble means and reconstructions.

steps.description: Load necessary libraries and set up the environment for data processing and visualization.
steps.title: Setup Environment

steps.description: Load GMST data from a NetCDF file and process it for visualization. Create a new DataFrame to store processed data and calculate ensemble means.
steps.title: Load and Process GMST Data

steps.description: Load NHT data from a NetCDF file and a text file. Compare reconstructions by visualizing the data using line density plots.
steps.title: Load and Compare NHT Reconstructions

steps.description: Combine processed data and visualizations into a comprehensive figure for presentation. Export the top panel for inclusion in presentations.
steps.title: Assemble Figure 1
